title: Pair Fourier component
statement: For every pair $x=(x_0,x_1)\\in\{a,b,c\}^2$, the component of the indicator of the event that both coordinates equal $c$, at the full coordinate set $\{0,1\}$ in the three-point product Fourier basis, equals $4/9$ if $x_0=x_1=c$, equals $-2/9$ if exactly one coordinate is $c$, and equals $1/9$ if neither coordinate is $c$.
